title: Darouna jangal hai raat andheri
body:
Darouna jangal hai raat andheri sitaare kuch jhilmila rahe hai
pade hai rethi pa chand laashe jo apna gham aap khaa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aisa bigda hua zamana, na gorhai aur na shaamiyana
falak pe abre siya ke lagke, udaasi ban ban ke cha rahay hai
darona jungal...
<<DIVIDER>>
na koi laasho'n pe rone waala, no koi zakhmo ka dhone wala
parind kuch kar rahe hai naale, darind kuch qaak udaa rahe hai
darona jungal...
<<DIVIDER>>
Shikista hatyaar kuch pade hai, ye log shayad yaha'n lade hai
lade to woh honge jo bade hai, nazar to bachche bhi aa rahe hai
darona jungal...
<<DIVIDER>>
Haram pe kya guzri baad inke, nahi zaroorat ke koi pooche
jale hue jo pade hai khaime, woh unka lutna bata rahe hai
darona jungal...
<<DIVIDER>>
Shafa-at-e hashr karne wale, kahi'n jo woh kar guzarne wale
ghayoor hai woh marne wale, jo humko abtak rula rahe hai
darona jungal...
